text: Temperature is a measure of how hot or cold an object is. It is measured in degrees Celsius. The bigger the number, the higher the temperature. Fifty degrees Celsius is hotter than ten degrees Celsius.
In your exam, say it like this. Temperature is a measure of how hot or cold an object is, measured in degrees Celsius using a thermometer. Our sense of touch cannot measure temperature accurately.

Now start a new mind map. Heat in the middle. Add a branch for temperature. Measured in degrees Celsius, with a thermometer. Add the three types of thermometers. Save it in TheOneApp, the ultimate science app. Tap Mind maps, then, Make my own mind map.
